key_structures: Garbhagriha (inner sanctum with ancient swayambhu and utsava murti)
Gopuram-style gateway spire adorned with sculpted deities
Sub-shrine of Annapurna and Kala Bhairava
Mir Ghat access steps leading from River Ganga
special_features: Two murtis in sanctum: an ancient small stone deity behind and a majestic granite murti in front
Ornate granite carving reflecting South Indian temple design within the lanes of ancient Kashi
Proximity to the Manikarnika and Mir Ghats
renovation_history: Ancient sanctum mentioned in Puranas; extensively renovated and consecrated by Nattukottai Chettiar community in 1908 and 1971 CE.
